payload.outcome: The Today check-in sheet (src/components/teaching/teaching-code-sheet.tsx) already offers "Scan in app" (BarcodeDetector) with the typed code as fallback. iPhone Safari has no BarcodeDetector, so the Teaching and CME PR (21 Oct 2026) hides "Scan in app" there and leaves the phone Camera app and 6-digit code wording, instead of adding a decoding library.
